title: Christmas Bingo Printable, Woodland Christmas Party Game for Kids & Family, 30 Unique Picture Bingo Cards, Classroom Holiday Game, pdf
description:
A cozy woodland twist on Christmas bingo: foxes, owls, robins, hedgehogs, snowy cabins, mittens and mugs of cocoa, all drawn in a warm dusk palette of plum, pine, berry and gold. Print it tonight and play at your family Christmas party, a classroom holiday party, a church or club get-together, or a quiet night in.

Every one of the 30 cards is different. Each card has 24 of the 30 woodland pictures and a FREE space, no two cards have the same set of pictures, and no two cards share a winning row, column or diagonal, so ties are rare. Every picture is on 24 of the 30 cards, so every player has the same chance. The pictures are big and clear, so children who can't read yet can play (and even be the caller).

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 30 unique 5×5 bingo cards, 2 per page (cut each page in half)
• 30 calling cards to cut apart and draw from a bowl or stocking
• Caller's checklist to tick off each picture as it's called
• 80 bingo markers to cut out (or use candy, buttons or mini marshmallows)
• How to play page with 5 ways to win: any line, four corners, snowy X, picture frame and blackout
• 2 pdf files: US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) and A4, 20 pages each

THE 30 PICTURES
Fox, owl, stag, robin, pine tree, mushroom, lantern, mitten, star, sled, cabin, snowflake, acorn, holly, pinecone, hedgehog, rabbit, wreath, candle, cocoa, scarf, gift, moon, bird house, squirrel, bear, stocking, bell, snowman and ice skate.

GOOD TO KNOW
• For 2 to 30 players, ages 3 and up
• White backgrounds and light colours, so it's easy on your ink
• Print at 100% (actual size) on plain paper or card stock; slip cards into sheet protectors and use dry-erase markers to reuse them every year

LICENSE
Personal use: print as many copies as you like for your own family, party or classroom. Please don't share, resell or redistribute the files or printed copies.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. The files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP from Duskwood Designs Co. Printing, paper and cutting are not included.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand.
